membership.navigation.schemes.label: Schemes
membership.navigation.mine.label: Membership
membership.screens.sides.members-help: Holders become members: the members' area opens for them while the membership is current.
membership.screens.sides.audience-help: For Friends and supporters: benefits such as a ticket price, never the members' area.
membership.screens.length-rules.rolling-: Each membership runs for a number of months from the day it starts.
membership.screens.length-rules.fixed: To a set day each year
membership.screens.length-rules.fixed-he: Every membership ends on the same day of the year, whenever it was taken.
membership.screens.length-rules.indefini: For honorary and life memberships. It never lapses.
membership.screens.join-modes.apply-help: Shown in My account with a button to join.
membership.screens.join-modes.staff-only: For honorary and life memberships, or members another body tells you about.
membership.screens.checklist.length-opti: Add at least one length people can hold it for.
membership.screens.checklist.members-are: Switch the members' area on, or put the scheme on the supporters' side.
membership.screens.checklist.verifier: Checking members is not available yet. Remove the check to open this scheme.
membership.screens.checklist.application: Approval needs an application form, which is not available yet.
membership.screens.checklist.price: Charging for membership is not available yet.
membership.screens.schemes.help: The memberships the theatre offers. A scheme starts as a draft and opens once it is ready.
membership.screens.schemes.empty-help: Create a scheme for your members, or for Friends and supporters.
membership.screens.scheme.name: Name
membership.screens.scheme.name-help: Such as "Student member" or "Friend of the theatre".
membership.screens.scheme.key-help: Used in the address of the join page. Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
membership.screens.scheme.key-fixed: Fixed now the scheme has been opened, because people may have the address saved.
membership.screens.scheme.summary-help: One or two sentences shown where schemes are listed.
membership.screens.scheme.side-help: Whether holding it makes somebody a member.
membership.screens.scheme.side-locked: Fixed now that somebody has held this scheme. Close it and create another to change sides.
membership.screens.scheme.fixed-end-help: The day every membership ends. 29 February is not offered.
membership.screens.scheme.rollover: Days before the end that count as next year
membership.screens.scheme.rollover-help: Somebody joining this close to the end date is given the following year as well.
membership.screens.scheme.renewal-opens: Days before the end renewal opens
membership.screens.scheme.grace-help: How long a membership still counts after its end date.
membership.screens.scheme.holder-may-end: Holders may end their own membership
Turn this off where another body, such as a students' union, owns the membership.
membership.screens.scheme.confirm-closed: Nobody new can join. Current members keep their membership and can still renew.
membership.screens.scheme.confirm-archiv: It is hidden from lists. Current memberships run to their end and cannot be renewed.
membership.screens.scheme.confirm-delete: The draft and its lengths are deleted.
membership.screens.lengths.title: Lengths
membership.screens.lengths.help: What people can hold this scheme for, such as 1 year and 3 years. Counted in {unit}.
membership.screens.lengths.indefinite: A scheme that lasts until somebody ends it has no lengths.
membership.screens.lengths.withdrawn: Withdrawn: nobody new can choose it
membership.screens.lengths.name: Name
membership.screens.add-member.title: Add member
membership.screens.add-member.help: The membership is active straight away. If nobody has an account with this address, one is made for them to claim when they first sign in.
membership.screens.add-member.name: Name
membership.screens.add-member.name-help: Used only if a new account is made.
membership.screens.add-member.ends-help: Leave empty to follow the scheme's length.
membership.screens.add-member.opens-area: They will see the members' area the next time they open a page.
membership.screens.add-member.no-area: This is a supporters' scheme, so they will not see the members' area.
membership.screens.mine.none: You do not hold a membership. See what the theatre offers.
membership.screens.mine.nothing-to-join: There is nothing else to join at the moment.
